narrative:
## Handover Summary — NII & Fee Income Planning

Income validated across six business lines, eighteen products and five currencies. The Interest & Fee Income Agent generated 15 proposals; 11 were accepted.

## Key Decisions
• Retail mortgage yield reset for Euribor 12M repricing (−EUR 0.9M)
• Treasury reinvestment at current EU sovereign yields (−EUR 0.7M)
• Private-banking fee uplift from discretionary-mandate conversions (+EUR 1.3M)
• Tressis flow uplift (+EUR 1.5M)

## Recommendation for Provisions & Cost of Risk
Corporate lending growth and two hospitality names on the watch list mean the credit team should re-run Stage 2 migration before the forecast is locked.
